title: Sr. Designer, Brand & Communications
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a highly skilled Senior Designer to join our Brand \& Communications team from one of our India office locations. This role will help bring the Candescent brand to life across internal, client\-facing, executive, event, digital, and sales enablement materials. The ideal candidate combines strong design craft, production discipline, visual problem\-solving, and brand stewardship with the ability to move quickly across a wide range of requests.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on design role, not a review\-only or coordination role. The Senior Designer will personally create, refine, and finalize high\-quality work while partnering closely with brand, communications, marketing, product marketing, sales, events, and executive stakeholders. Success requires excellent judgment, strong typography and layout skills, comfort with content\-heavy materials, and the ability to maintain a consistent visual standard across every touchpoint.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities and Deliverables
   

  

*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
 Brand Design \& Visual Execution
   

  

* Create polished visual solutions across digital, print, presentation, event, environmental, sales enablement, and internal communications projects.
* Design a wide range of assets including executive presentations, sales and marketing decks, one\-pagers, ebooks, infographics, newsletters, social graphics, event materials, signage, and internal communications visuals.
* Translate complex, content\-heavy, or abstract information into clear, engaging, and visually compelling communications.
* Elevate layouts, typography, hierarchy, imagery, icons, charts, and data visualizations so materials are easy to understand and unmistakably on brand.


 Brand Consistency \& Design Systems
   

  

* Apply and extend Candescent brand standards across all assigned work, including typography, color, layout, iconography, imagery, presentation systems, and data visualization.
* Help maintain a consistent visual experience across internal and external channels, ensuring work feels connected, professional, and aligned to the company’s brand narrative.
* Use established templates and systems appropriately, while identifying opportunities to improve usability, scalability, and consistency.
* Spot and correct brand drift, formatting inconsistencies, visual clutter, and production issues before materials are delivered.


 Production, Quality Control \& Delivery
   

  

* Prepare accurate, production\-ready files for digital, print, presentation, large\-format, and event applications.
* Proof work carefully for alignment, spacing, hierarchy, accuracy, pagination, export settings, image quality, and brand compliance.
* Manage multiple projects and deadlines at once while maintaining a high standard of craft and attention to detail.
* Respond quickly to feedback, incorporate revisions thoughtfully, and deliver final assets that require minimal rework.


 Cross\-Functional Collaboration
   

  

* Partner with Brand \& Communications team members and cross\-functional stakeholders to clarify objectives, understand audiences, and translate business needs into effective visual communications.
* Collaborate with US\-based stakeholders and global team members through clear communication, organized handoffs, and reliable follow\-through.
* Work with agencies, vendors, freelancers, or production partners when needed, providing files, feedback, specifications, and guidance that support high\-quality outcomes.
* Operate with ownership and accountability, knowing when to ask questions, when to recommend a stronger solution, and when to move quickly to execution.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 7\+ years of professional graphic design experience, preferably within an in\-house creative team, agency, corporate brand team, B2B, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise environment.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design execution across presentations, print, digital, sales enablement, events, internal communications, and brand storytelling materials.
* Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Advanced PowerPoint design skills, including executive\-level presentations, slide systems, master templates, visual hierarchy, charts, diagrams, and content\-heavy storytelling.
* Strong typography, layout, composition, information design, and visual storytelling skills.
* Deep understanding of brand systems and how to apply them consistently across multiple channels, audiences, and formats.
* Strong production knowledge, including file preparation, print production, vendor coordination, export specifications, and large\-format applications.
* Experience turning complex or technical subject matter into clear, polished, visually engaging communications.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects, adapt to shifting priorities, and deliver high\-quality work on deadline.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly and professionally.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, Fine Arts, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience designing for executive, client, consultant, partner, or sales audiences is preferred.
* Experience with Figma, Canva, After Effects, motion graphics, web design, or digital campaign tools is a plus.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Brand and communications materials are polished, consistent, accurate, and recognizably Candescent across every touchpoint.
* Executive, client\-facing, sales, and internal materials are visually clear, easy to follow, and delivered with a high level of craft.
* The Brand \& Communications team can rely on this role for dependable, hands\-on execution with minimal rework.
* Templates, systems, and recurring materials become easier to use, more consistent, and faster to produce over time.
* Stakeholders receive thoughtful design partnership, clear communication, and high\-quality deliverables on deadline.
* The candidate demonstrates ownership, flexibility, and sound judgment while supporting a lean, fast\-moving global team.


 What Will Make You Successful
   

  

* Outstanding typography, layout, and information design skills.
* Strong visual judgment, meticulous attention to detail, and a commitment to design craftsmanship.
* Ability to create polished, production\-ready work with minimal direction.
* Comfort moving quickly between projects while maintaining a consistently high quality bar.
* A practical understanding of how design supports brand perception, business goals, sales effectiveness, employee engagement, and client confidence.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style with the confidence to recommend stronger design solutions when needed.
* Strong organization, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a thoughtful, detail\-oriented UI/UX Designer to shape the look, feel, and usability of our website and digital experiences from one of our India office locations. You will design intuitive, on\-brand experiences from wireframe through high\-fidelity mockup, working closely with web, marketing, and product marketing teams to bring ideas to life.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on design role for someone who enjoys solving user problems through clean, purposeful design and who wants to see their work built and shipped quickly. You will work closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Design \& Delivery**
* Design wireframes, mockups, and high\-fidelity UI for web pages, landing pages, and digital experiences in Figma.
* Translate business goals and user needs into intuitive user flows and information architecture.
* Design and iterate on landing pages and campaign assets in support of marketing and demand generation initiatives.
* Support A/B testing initiatives by designing test variants for key pages and conversion flows.


**Design Systems \& Consistency**
* Create and maintain a design system and component library to ensure visual consistency across the site.
* Apply Candescent brand standards consistently across all digital work, including typography, colour, iconography, and imagery.
* Ensure designs follow accessibility best practices (WCAG) and are optimised for performance.


**Research \& Validation**
* Conduct or contribute to user research and usability testing, and gather feedback to inform design decisions.
* Use analytics and test results to identify usability problems and prioritise improvements.
* Stay current on design trends, tools, and best practices, and bring fresh ideas to the team.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Collaborate closely with the web development team to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively, and support a clean handoff.
* Partner with stakeholders across marketing, product marketing, and sales to gather requirements and present design concepts.
* Present and explain design decisions clearly, and incorporate feedback constructively.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 3–5 years of experience in UI/UX design, preferably for web or digital marketing.
* Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, auto layout, and prototyping.
* Solid portfolio demonstrating strong visual design, typography, and layout skills.
* Understanding of responsive design principles and designing for multiple breakpoints and devices.
* Working knowledge of UX best practices, user flows, and information architecture.
* Ability to translate business and marketing goals into clear, user\-centred design solutions.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present and explain design decisions to stakeholders.
* Detail\-oriented, with a strong sense of visual polish and consistency.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a strong portfolio will be considered.
* Hands\-on experience building or editing sites in Webflow is preferred.
* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS and how designs translate to code is preferred.
* Experience with user research or usability testing methods is a plus.
* Familiarity with A/B testing and conversion rate optimisation principles is a plus.
* Experience designing for SEO\-friendly page structures is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Designs are intuitive, on\-brand, and elevate the overall user experience.
* Design\-to\-development handoff is smooth, with minimal rework needed.
* A well\-maintained, scalable design system that speeds up future work.
* Measurable improvements in usability and conversion on redesigned pages.
* Stakeholders receive clear rationale for design decisions, not just deliverables.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Genuine curiosity about how users behave, and willingness to let evidence change the design.
* Comfort designing within an established brand system rather than starting from a blank page.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Portfolio Submission**
*Required with every application*
 A portfolio is mandatory for consideration. Applications submitted without a portfolio link or PDF will not be reviewed. Please include a link to an online portfolio or an attached PDF, with access credentials if the work is password protected, along with three to five selected pieces that best demonstrate your web and digital design work. For each piece, include a short note describing the brief, your specific contribution, and the outcome.
   

  

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Designer - BIM HVAC
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

**Description**
 Jacobs is seeking a BIM Modeler/ CAD Drafter, who will provide drafting and modeling support for HVAC service. This position requires proficiency in Autodesk software, specifically AutoCAD and Revit. Candidates must have a minimum of 7 years\- experience providing BIM execution oversight, model management, model QC and VDC support. Knowledge of plumbing and Fire fighting service modelling will be an added advantage.
   

  

**Daily Duties/Tasks**
* Sizing of HVAC ducts and Pipe along with routing.
* Space Planning of HVAC Equipment’s.
* Co\-ordination with other disciplines.
* Modelling of Plumbing and Fire Fighting Service.
* Provide CAD drafting/BIM modeling and design support
* Coordinate and manage Revit models
* Create Revit families and CAD blocks.
* Obtain work assignments of either specific design elements or CAD drafting from project managers
* Review all work for completeness and accuracy
* Use checklists set\-up for quality control on each project and submit work according to deadlines.
* Provide an accurate accounting of time spent on projects with descriptions for each time entry on a weekly basis
* Complete printing and plotting requests
* Observe professional ethics
* Demonstrate proactive approach to learning of new digital design tools


**Additional Responsibilities Are As Follows**
* Ensures compliance with the approved BIM Execution and BIM Scope Plans
* Setting up project base files
* Assemble composite design models for coordination meetings
* Facilitate use of composite design models in design coordination/clash detection meetings and provides detection reports by the identification and resolution of all hard and soft collisions
* Coordinate BIM file exchange and archiving of milestone submittals.


 Here's what you'll need
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Five\+ years of Revit experience plus two\+ years of AutoCAD experience.
* Understanding of MEP Systems
* Knowledge of, and proven practical background in, Autodesk Revit and related Building Information Modeling software
* Solid understanding of legacy CAD applications and practices, particularly AutoCAD.
* Familiarity with Design Visualization applications such as Autodesk 360 (Cloud Rendering), 3D Studio Max and Navisworks.
* Familiarity with ProjectWise, MicroStation Echo Sim 3D and Bluebeam Software’s.


**Expectations**
* Ability to articulately convey (verbally, visually, graphically) digital design concepts to design and delivery professionals with varying levels of understanding
* Demonstrate a reliable, responsive, and positive work ethic with the highest degree of integrity.
* Ability to exercise judgment and discretion and to set priorities and manage competing demands.
* Demonstrated ability to develop learning material, deliver effective training and provide ongoing education and support to Revit project teams
* Punctuality.
* Ability to adhere to deadlines.
* Possess a strong work ethic.
* Experience on Hospitality (Malls, Hotels, Residential, High Rise Building, Mixed Use projects), Healthcare, Aviation and Rail Sector will be an added advantage.
* Experience working with Middle East region is an added advantage


 At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
   

  

 Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
   

  

 At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
   

  

 We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
   

  

 Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Storefront and eCommerce
description:
* About the role


 As our Storefront and CRO Manager, you will be the centre of expertise for everything that happens on our storefronts. You will own and drive the storefront experience for Crazy Domains, Vodien and BigRock, and support the wider Digipac group of brands.
   

  

 Our brands sit across a mix of platforms including WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager and our own in\-house stack, with control panels managed separately. A significant part of this role is bringing a coherent roadmap, one standard of experience and one testing discipline across all of them, while respecting where each brand needs to be different.
   

  

 You will be accountable for the storefront roadmap and for the commercial outcomes that come with it, with a focus on conversion rate, cross sell, and the overall quality of the customer experience. You will work with marketing, design, engineering, analytics and brand teams to make sure everything that ships is consistent with our wider eCommerce and marketing strategy.
   

  

 This role offers a largely remote working experience with flexible working hours and the opportunity to work with teams across the globe.
   

  

* Job Description


**What You Will Own**
 Targets are agreed by brand at the start of each financial year with the eCommerce and brand leads. Baselines are set in your first quarter.
   

  

**Revenue and conversion**
* Storefront conversion rate. Improve visit to cart and cart to purchase across priority funnels for each brand.
* Cross sell and attach rate. Grow attach of adjacent products at cart, checkout and in the control panel, measured by attach rate and revenue per visit.
* Average order value and revenue per session. Own the onsite levers that move both, including merchandising, pricing presentation, bundling and upgrade paths.


**Experience And Performance**
* Site performance. Page load and Core Web Vitals on key templates, with particular attention to mobile.
* Experience quality. Reduction in onsite defects reaching production, faster time to resolution on storefront bugs, improved task success and friction scores from behavioral and qualitative research.
* Consistency across brands. A shared component and experience standard applied across the portfolio, so that a fix or a win on one brand can be reused rather than rebuilt.


**Delivery and process**
* Experimentation velocity. An agreed number of tests live per quarter, each with a documented hypothesis, a clean readout and a decision logged, whether the test wins or loses.
* Roadmap delivery. Percentage of committed roadmap delivered in the quarter, and cycle time from PRD to live.
* Delivery against Strategi Project. Own and deliver platform support where applicable for strategic global projects such as brand migrations and consolidations


**A day in the life of our Storefront and Conversion Manager**
**Core deliverables**
* Build, maintain and track the storefront and control panel roadmap across Crazy Domains, Vodien, BigRock and the Digipac brands, keeping it continuously aligned with business strategy and with the commercial priorities of each brand.
* Manage the execution of storefront and customer panel driven marketing, UX and product initiatives from idea through to live.
* Run a continuous onsite testing program, using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and other forms of customer insight, and turn what you learn into a prioritized backlog rather than a folder of results.
* Create PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and build wireframes and high level mockups in Figma alongside our Design team to define desired outcomes.
* Make and manage day to day content, layout and campaign updates on our WordPress properties, and scope and brief larger changes to engineering for our AEM and in\-house stacks.
* Lead storefront redesign and rebranding work as it comes up, covering page templates, navigation, product and pricing pages, cart and checkout.
* Worl closely with storefront QA and pre release teams, so that what goes live matches what was specified and does not quietly break something else.
* Actively participate in and represent marketing in weekly project grooming, sprint planning and release readiness in Jira.
* Continuously measure and report key storefront metrics including conversion rate, click and engagement metrics, funnel drop off and load time.


**Stakeholder management**
* Proactively manage all relevant stakeholders including senior management, building consensus and commitment to project outcomes.
* Work with brand and marketing leads across the portfolio to sequence competing requests into a single roadmap, and be comfortable explaining why something is not being built this quarter.
* Work collaboratively with cross functional stakeholders and in close conjunction with design and engineering teams to align on roadmaps and deliverables across all three stacks.
* Engage and cultivate relationships with partners across the business, gain insight and adopt best practices.
* Partner closely with Analytics and BI teams to evolve our understanding of performance across eCommerce.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales and support teams on go to market planning for products and campaigns.
* Close the loop with customer support and care teams, using what they hear every day as a source of onsite improvements.


**Data and analysis**
* Monitor, report and find ways to improve platform performance across brands and funnel steps.
* Work with the BI team to build visibility for key platform metrics, including dashboards that let brand teams self serve.
* Investigate anomalies and conversion drops quickly, and separate a tracking problem from a real experience problem.
* Analyze data from internal and external sources to develop strategies and define platform objectives.
* Leverage data and insight to continually optimize and maximize the value of our platform and processes.
* Benchmark our storefronts against competitors and against good practice outside our category.


* Additional Job Description


**What You Will Need To Succeed**
* Five or more years in eCommerce, conversion rate optimization, digital product or web experience roles, ideally across multiple brands or markets.
* A demonstrable track record of moving conversion rate, attach rate or average order value, with the ability to talk through how you did it and what you learned when it did not work.
* A keen eye for good design and a strong understanding of user experience.
* A customer first mindset and the ability to apply design thinking principles.
* Data driven, but able to make a judgement call when the data is thin or the sample is small.
* Strong working knowledge of tracking customer journeys, event and tag setup, and the ability to analyze and act on what you see.
* Hands on experience with Figma and Jira. Both are everyday tools in this role, not occasional ones.
* Comfortable working directly in AEM/WordPress (or have the willingness to learn this). You should be able to make and QA basic content, layout and template updates yourself without waiting in a development queue. Experience with Adobe Experience Manager or a similar enterprise CMS is a strong advantage.
* A working understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Enough to read a page, spot what is wrong, estimate effort and hold a credible conversation with engineers. You will not be asked to ship production code.
* Experience with analytics and experimentation tooling such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and similar.
* Strong communication, organizational and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail, comfort with multitasking, and a customer service focus.
* Independent thinking, and not being afraid to suggest new ideas.
* Experience working in an agile organization or with cross functional teams.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
* Driven by delivery, delivering on time and to a high standard.


**Nice to have**
* Experience in domains, hosting, SaaS or subscription businesses.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals and how onsite changes affect organic performance.
* Exposure to Adobe Analytics or Adobe Target.
* Working knowledge of accessibility standards and page speed optimization.
* Experience working across multiple time zones and distributed teams.


**What Success Looks Like**
**First 90 days.** 
 You know our stacks, our funnels and our numbers. You have audited the storefronts across brands, established a clean baseline for conversion, attach and performance, and shipped a first set of quick wins.
   

  

**First six months.** 
 A prioritized storefront roadmap is agreed with brand and engineering leads, a regular testing cadence is running, and reporting is in place that everyone trusts and uses.
   

  

**First twelve months.** 
 Measurable improvement against your conversion, attach and performance targets, a shared experience standard applied across brands, and a healthy backlog of tested, evidenced ideas ready for the following year.
   

  

**Why you'll love us.**
* We've evolved; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work\-from\- home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.
* Work\-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 \+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* We care about you. At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with \#teamnewfold

The Company reserves the right to revise the Job Description at any time, and to require the employee to perform functions in addition to those listed above.**

title: Graphic Designer
description:
**Overview**
 The Graphic Designer plays a key role in bringing the Fueling Brains brand to life through compelling visual storytelling across digital and print platforms. This position is responsible for creating high\-quality creative assets that support marketing campaigns, website initiatives, content creation, brand awareness, and business development efforts.
   

  

 Rooted in the Fueling Brains mission and values, the Graphic Designer collaborates closely with Marketing, Content, Digital, and Leadership teams to ensure all visual communications are engaging, consistent, and aligned with the organization's brand standards. This role requires a strong eye for design, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to transform ideas into impactful visual experiences.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
 Creative Design \& Brand Development
   

  

* Design visually compelling marketing materials that align with Fueling Brains’ brand identity and strategic objectives.
* Create graphics for digital and print marketing campaigns, including brochures, flyers, presentations, event materials, signage, outdoor advertising and promotional assets.
* Develop and maintain brand consistency across all marketing and communication channels.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate concepts, messaging, and objectives into engaging visual designs.
* Design creative assets that support lead generation and customer acquisition.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution and enhancement of the Fueling Brains visual brand.


 Website Design \& Digital Assets
   

  

* Design banners, landing page graphics, illustrations, icons, and other visual assets for the Fueling Brains WordPress website.
* Work closely with the marketing and web development teams to improve website user experience and visual appeal.
* Create graphics optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile experiences.
* Ensure website visuals are aligned with branding guidelines and conversion\-focused marketing goals.


 Content Creation \& Social Media Design
   

  

* Develop engaging social media creatives for platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and other digital channels.
* Create and adapt creative assets for paid media campaigns across Meta, Google and other digital channels.
* Design visual assets for blogs, newsletters, webinars, email campaigns, and content marketing initiatives.
* Create infographics and visual storytelling elements that simplify complex ideas and enhance audience engagement.
* Support video and multimedia projects through graphic elements, thumbnails, and motion graphics where applicable.


 Marketing Campaign Support
   

  

* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop creative concepts and campaign materials.
* Design digital advertisements, promotional campaigns, and lead\-generation assets.
* Produce high\-quality visuals that support brand awareness, customer acquisition, and community engagement initiatives.
* Ensure all creative deliverables are completed accurately and within project timelines.
* Develop creative variations based on campaign objectives, audience segments, platform requirements and ad specifications.


 Team Collaboration \& Project Management
   

  

* Work collaboratively with content writers, marketers, developers, and leadership teams.
